{"subject": "Billing dispute - account [ACCOUNT_1], September 2026 bill", "body": "Dear Billing Review Team,

I am writing to dispute the charge of $612.40 on my bill for the service period September 1 - September 30, 2026 (account [ACCOUNT_1], service address [ADDRESS_1]).

The bill shows usage of 2,940 kWh, about 3.1 times my 12-month average of 948 kWh. This is far above my normal usage, and I believe the meter reading or the charge may be incorrect.

Under Section 14.2 of your Customer Service Rules, I ask that you:
1. review this charge as a billing dispute, with collection on the disputed amount suspended and no late fee applied while it is under review; and
2. carry out a free meter accuracy test.

I will continue to pay any undisputed charges. Please contact me at [PHONE_1] or [EMAIL_2] with the result of the review.

Sincerely,
[NAME_1]"}
